senses.gloss:
इङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
 1. Moveable, locomotive.
 2. Surprising, wonder-
ful.
 m. (-ङ्गः)
 1. A hint or sign, an indication of sentiment by
gesture, &c.
 2. Knowledge.
 E. इगि to go, affix क.

इङ्गित n. (-तं)
 1. Hint, sign, gesture.
 2. Going, motion.
 3. Intention,
purpose.
 E. इगि to go, affix क्त.

इङ्गितज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Understanding signs.
 E. इङ्गित and ज्ञ who knows.

इङ्गुद mf. (-दः-दी) The name of a plant, commonly Ingua
 E. इङ्गु going,
and द what gives; the pen. अ is changed to उ and the fem. affix
is ङीष्.
इङ्गुल mf. (-लः-ली) See the preceding. E. As before, द being changed to ल.
